name: binance-mcp
description: Binance USD-M Futures (trading): me, list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles, get_balances, list_order

platform_mcp_binance_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BINANCE_API_KEY
platform_mcp_binance_api_key.description: Binance API key (sent as X-MBX-APIKEY). Create it under API Management with withdrawals OFF; restrict it to your IP. Futures testnet: create a key at https://testnet.binancefuture.com and point adapter.base_url there (testnet keys only work on the testnet host).

platform_mcp_binance_api_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BINANCE_API_SECRET
platform_mcp_binance_api_secret.description: The key's HMAC secret: signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over the exact query string, appended as `signature` after `timestamp`). Never sent on the wire.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Signed GET /fapi/v1/accountConfig (weight 5): canTrade, canWithdraw, dualSidePosition (Hedge mode), multiAssetsMargin, feeTier.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every contract in one response (no pagination; `query` is not sent). `raw` carries filters and precisions.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: 24h rolling statistics; decimal strings passed through. Futures tickers carry no bid/ask (that is /ticker/bookTicker, not mapped).

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: Intervals 1m,3m,5m,15m,30m,1h,2h,4h,6h,8h,12h,1d,3d,1w,1M. Rows are positional arrays (oldest first); `time` is the open time in ms and prices are decimal strings. Rows carry prices as decimal strings (and Binance the open time as an integer); they are returned as numbers and `time` as a string, as the vocabulary types them (live check 2026-09-26: the raw values failed the output schema).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Open orders only; without `symbol` the call is heavy (weight 40). `status` is not sent.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: PLACES A REAL ORDER WITH REAL FUNDS on the configured host; it is not a simulation. Test with the futures testnet https://testnet.binancefuture.com first (edit adapter.base_url to point there), and never place an order the user has not explicitly confirmed. This opens or adds to a LEVERAGED position at the account's current leverage. `quantity` is in the base asset (e.g. BTC for BTCUSDT). Limit orders are sent with timeInForce=GTC and need `price`; omit `price` for market orders. positionSide is not sent (One-way mode); an account in Hedge mode rejects the order.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Binance requires `symbol` together with the order id.
